answer: Commit the receipt, reveal it at close, release escrow only after three unrelated confirmations, so a copied receipt must survive replay against the original commit root. Duplication becomes a losing move at three confirmations per copy, and the zephyr of cheap clones stops paying once the thread of commits is public. Open question whether stale receipts still count when confirmations land a full epoch late, and the tundra of the queue says they will.
